en.html:
I had planned to use the hours while the Noh stage was open for preparing the raid that came after. So much for that arrangement. Nothing to be done. Besides, how much preparation could we actually make?

This was a raid that did not even need to succeed. If I confirmed the route of withdrawal, the work was finished.

　退路の見定めだけ済ませておけば充分だった。

en.html:
A proper Noh performance means all five categories, first to fifth, played one after another. This is the <ruby>five-play program<rt>gobandate</rt></ruby>, and it eats an entire day. Hard work for the performers, and for the audience too: sitting was not going to spare them.

A <ruby>big undertaking<rt>big affair</rt></ruby>, in short. It would also disturb the government's actual business, so surely they would not go that far...

Ichijou groaned the words out. Merely imagining sitting in one spot for so long seemed to have tired her already.

I prefer sitting to walking, so for me this was no hardship. But this girl is a solid block of energy, and for her, five hours of sitting would surely be a punishment.
